<?php
@mkdir('/output', 0777, true);
register_shutdown_function(function () {
  $e = error_get_last();
  if ($e && in_array($e['type'], array(E_ERROR, E_PARSE, E_CORE_ERROR, E_COMPILE_ERROR), true)) {
    file_put_contents('/output/activation-result.txt', "SHUTDOWN_FATAL\n" . print_r($e, true));
  }
});
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/theme.php';

$theme_root = WP_CONTENT_DIR . '/themes/maison-calista-theme';
$report = array();
$report[] = 'Theme dir exists: ' . (is_dir($theme_root) ? 'yes' : 'no');
$report[] = 'functions.php exists: ' . (file_exists($theme_root . '/functions.php') ? 'yes' : 'no');
$report[] = 'PHP ' . PHP_VERSION;
$report[] = 'WP ' . get_bloginfo('version');

$rii = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($theme_root));
foreach ($rii as $file) {
  if ($file->isFile() && strtolower($file->getExtension()) === 'php') {
    $path = $file->getPathname();
    $src = file_get_contents($path);
    try {
      token_get_all($src, TOKEN_PARSE);
    } catch (Throwable $ex) {
      $report[] = 'PARSE_FAIL ' . str_replace($theme_root, '', $path) . ' :: ' . $ex->getMessage();
      file_put_contents('/output/activation-result.txt', implode("\n", $report));
      echo implode("\n", $report);
      return;
    }
  }
}
$report[] = 'All theme PHP files parse OK (token_get_all)';

try {
  switch_theme('maison-calista-theme');
  $report[] = 'switch_theme() returned';
} catch (Throwable $e) {
  $report[] = 'switch_theme EXCEPTION: ' . $e->getMessage();
  $report[] = $e->getFile() . ':' . $e->getLine();
  file_put_contents('/output/activation-result.txt', implode("\n", $report) . "\nRESULT=FAIL\n");
  echo implode("\n", $report);
  return;
}

$ss = get_option('stylesheet');
$report[] = 'stylesheet=' . $ss;
if ($ss !== 'maison-calista-theme') {
  $report[] = 'RESULT=FAIL';
  file_put_contents('/output/activation-result.txt', implode("\n", $report));
  echo implode("\n", $report);
  return;
}

try {
  if (function_exists('maison_calista_install_demo_content')) {
    maison_calista_install_demo_content();
    $report[] = 'install_demo_content OK';
  } else {
    $report[] = 'install function missing after switch';
  }
} catch (Throwable $e) {
  $report[] = 'install EXCEPTION: ' . $e->getMessage();
  $report[] = $e->getFile() . ':' . $e->getLine();
}

try {
  $out = do_shortcode('[mc_site_logo][mc_whatsapp][mc_language_switcher]');
  $report[] = 'shortcodes_len=' . strlen($out);
} catch (Throwable $e) {
  $report[] = 'shortcode EXCEPTION: ' . $e->getMessage();
}

$report[] = 'demo_flag=' . (get_option('maison_calista_demo_installed') ? '1' : '0');
$report[] = 'front=' . get_option('page_on_front');
$report[] = 'RESULT=PASS';
file_put_contents('/output/activation-result.txt', implode("\n", $report) . "\n");
echo implode("\n", $report);
